listBibl.bibl: Felix Liebermann, Die Gesetze der Angelsachsen, vol. 1 (Halle: Niemeyer, 1903), p. 436

An English crib of the Latin text, semi-literal, made for this database in 2026 with Claude, a large language model (LLM) made by Anthropic. It keeps close to the wording of the original and uses the established English of Anglo-Latin legal, liturgical and canon-law formulae. It is an aid to reading the original, not a published translation. Square brackets mark Liebermann’s additions to the text or, now and then, words supplied for the sense; “[?]” marks a doubtful reading

div.head: Excom VI 1.1
div.ab: et ex aduentu domini nostri Ihesu Christi et ex natiuitate et passione et morte et resurrectione et gloriosa ascensione et aduentu in die iudicii, quando uenerit separare iustos et iniustos, uelut pastor segregat oues ab hedis,
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 436 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: and by the advent of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the nativity and passion and death and resurrection and glorious ascension, and the coming on the day of judgment, when he shall come to separate the just and the unjust, as the shepherd separates the sheep from the goats,
